title: BreiwalkerSMP
description: One of the Best Survival Multiplayer Servers styled Like DonutSMP, including: /sell, /shop, /orders, /ah, /rtp, /tpa and Even coinflips. Also Theres no Pay to Win.
body:
🍩 Welcome to BreiwalkerSMP!

Looking for the ultimate Anarchy-Lite experience? BreiwalkerSMP is the place to be! Inspired by the legendary DonutSMP, we offer a massive, persistent world where your survival depends on your wits, your gear, and your alliances.
🛡️ Survival of the Fittest

On BreiwalkerSMP, we keep it raw and exciting. This isn't your average peaceful survival server—it’s a world of raiding, griefing, and massive player-run economies. Build a hidden base deep underground, form a powerful clan, or become a notorious mercenary. The choice is yours, but remember: trust no one!
💎 Why play on BreiwalkerSMP?

    Pure SMP Action: No boring "Hardcore" bans. If you fall, you get back up and seek revenge!

    Player-Driven Economy: Trade rare items and build your empire.

    No Rules, No Limits: Griefing and raiding are part of the game. Can you protect what’s yours?

    Seamless Crossplay: Join a few other players regardless of your device.

🔗 Connection Details

Ready to start your journey? Join the community today and make a name for yourself!

    Java IP: BreiwalkerSMP.net

    Bedrock IP: BreiwalkerSMP.net

    Bedrock Port: 19132
